top_signals.title: GM to Leave NYSE for Stock Listing on Tech-Focused Nasdaq
top_signals.summary: General Motors plans to shift its stock listing to the Nasdaq Global Select Market from the New York Stock Exchange to position the company as a tech-forward company. The company will retain the “GM” ticker symbol when it begins trading on the Nasdaq on Nov. 17, and the new listing offers eligibility for potential inclusion in the Nasdaq-100 Index. Bloomberg's David Welch joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
